title: openOODA Language Server
content:
## What it is

The Language Server Protocol implementation for openOODA. Brings completion, hover, definition, formatting, code actions, document symbols, and inlay hints to any LSP-aware editor (VS Code, Neovim, Helix, Emacs, Vim).

Invoked via `ooda lsp` (or your editor hosts the server directly).

## Install

The LSP server ships as part of the `ooda` toolchain. Once `ooda` is on PATH, you have `ooda lsp`.

## Surface

16 methods (4 lifecycle + 11 document + 1 workspace):

| Tier | Methods |
|------|---------|
| Lifecycle | `initialize`, `initialized`, `shutdown`, `exit` |
| Document | `textDocument/didOpen`, `didChange`, `completion`, `hover`, `definition`, `formatting`, `documentSymbol`, `codeAction`, `diagnostic`, `documentLink`, `inlayHint` |
| Workspace | `workspace/executeCommand` |
| Server-to-client | `textDocument/publishDiagnostics` |

The server advertises `completionProvider`, `hoverProvider`, `definitionProvider`, `referencesProvider`, `renameProvider`, `documentFormattingProvider`, `documentSymbolProvider`, `codeActionProvider`, `documentLinkProvider`, `inlayHintProvider`, and `workspace.executeCommandProvider` in the `initialize` response. It does not support `textDocument/didClose` (deliberate gap; the dispatcher has no `didClose` branch).
